name: Charge Limit
author: k7cfo
description: When you plug in, keep the 80% battery-life cap or charge to 100% for the day. Does not change power-profiles-daemon.

barWidget.description: Shows the charge cap. Click to hold at 80% or fill to 100%. A prompt also appears when you plug in.

schema.label: Battery-life cap (%)
schema.description: Where charging stops for everyday use. 80% is the usual laptop conservation stop. Start threshold is 5 points below, so the pack does not micro-cycle at the cap.

schema.label: Plug-in prompt timeout (seconds)
schema.description: If you ignore the prompt, the battery-life cap stays in place.

schema.label: Ask when plugging in
schema.description: Show the 80% / 100% choice when AC connects. The bar widget can still change the cap without unplugging.
